name: Antigravity Remote Control & Web UI
description: Installs Google Antigravity with support for local Web Ingress, Google Remote Control cloud tunnel, or both simultaneously.

version.description: The Antigravity version to install (e.g. latest, 2.9.1)

enableLocalInterface.description: Enable local HTTP/HTTPS server on port 52425 for internal Ingress / LAN access

enableRemoteControl.description: Enable outbound Google cloud proxy tunnel for access via antigravity.google

hostname.description: Custom instance nickname for this devcontainer in the antigravity.google dashboard
